ComboSection.laPlupartDesCombosPrecis: Most precise combos are below the threshold ({JUGEABLE_THRESHOLD}): that's expected. “Signal” = judgeable AND above the campaign median.

ComboCooldownSettingsButton.aQuelEcartUnMeme: How far apart the same script can go out again on another account, and how creators see it.

ComboCooldownSettingsCard.unScriptDejaProgrammeOu: A script already scheduled (or out) within this many days of a target date can't be reassigned to that date — even on another account, even for another creator.

ComboCooldownSettingsCard.unComboDejaAttribueEst: : a combo already assigned is frozen on its assignment. It doesn't touch
ComboCooldownSettingsCard.uneCreatriceNeRecoitJamais: either — a creator never gets the same script twice on the same platform, whatever this number is.

ComboCooldownSettingsCard.n0CooldownDesactiveUnMeme: 0 — cooldown off: the same script can go out again the same day on another account

ScenarioErreur.titre: {count, plural, one {# error in the bible} other {# errors in the bible}}
ScenarioErreur.autres: {count, plural, one {and # more error} other {and # more errors}}
ScenarioErreur.json: Unreadable JSON: a comma, quote or brace is missing.
ScenarioErreur.jsonLigne: Unreadable JSON at line {ligne}, column {colonne}: a comma, quote or brace is missing.
ScenarioErreur.entier: must be a positive whole number.
ScenarioErreur.date: invalid date “{valeur}”: YYYY-MM-DD, a date that exists.
ScenarioErreur.horodatage: invalid timestamp “{valeur}”: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
ScenarioErreur.horodatage_secondes: the hook screen needs seconds: “{valeur}” → YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
ScenarioErreur.nbElements: a message is [timestamp, who, text], a dialogue line [who, text].
ScenarioErreur.proba: must be a probability between 0 and 1.
ScenarioErreur.positif: must be a number greater than 0.
ScenarioErreur.paire: must be a [min, max] range of whole numbers, min ≤ max.
ScenarioErreur.prenom: first name not allowed in an export: no “:” or line break, 40 characters max.
ScenarioErreur.ordre_dates: dates out of order: start < honeymoon end ≤ turning point < end.
ScenarioErreur.hors_periode: the record day must fall after the start and no later than the last day.
ScenarioErreur.ecran_jour: the hook screen must be dated on the conversation's last day ({fin}).
ScenarioErreur.ecran_ordre: hook screen messages must be in chronological order.
ScenarioErreur.code_id: invalid code: short (20 characters max), no spaces, letters, digits, - or _.

TournagePage.sousTitre: For each creator and each story: a file in her name to import into BLUSH, then the filming link to paste here. Her mission gives her that file and that link, and nothing until the link is pasted.
TournagePage.etape1: “Prepare” makes her files: one per story, in her name. They never change afterwards.
TournagePage.etape2: In BLUSH (admin account): import each file, open its report and let it finish writing, then askblush.com/admin › Tournage › Créer le lien.
TournagePage.etape3: Copy the link and paste it next to the file, then Save.
TournagePage.accesRefuse: Reserved for people who manage scripts and campaigns.
TournagePage.rien: No creator or no active story yet.
TournagePage.preparer: Prepare {n, plural, one {her file} other {her # files}}
TournagePage.prepares: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing new to prepare} one {# file prepared} other {# files prepared}} for {nom}.
TournagePage.lienPlaceholder: Paste the BLUSH filming link here
TournagePage.lienEnregistre: Link saved: the creator sees it on her missions.
TournagePage.lienRetire: Link removed: her missions no longer offer this chat.
TournagePage.echecTelechargement: The file could not be downloaded. Try again.
TournagePage.etapeAuto1: “Prepare” makes her files (one per story, in her name, frozen) and asks BLUSH for each link: about 3 minutes, one paid reading (≈ €1) per file.
TournagePage.etapeAuto2: Links are set automatically, and her mission shows them right away. If something fails, the reason shows with “Retry”; you can also paste a link by hand.
TournagePage.liensDemandes: {n, plural, =0 {No link to request} one {# link requested from BLUSH (≈ 3 min)} other {# links requested from BLUSH (≈ 3 min)}}
